senses.gloss: m. (Palez of פטר) a prematurely born animal, a puny lamb.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 11a:3">Bekh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ פ׳ בר דנקא</he> even a puny lamb worth no more than a Danḳa.
<cite ref="Zevachim 48a:15">Zeb. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בר דנקא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חטאת בת ד׳</he>, <he>אשם בר ד׳</he>).
